title: Boolean conjunction as a product
statement: For any type $\alpha$, list $l : \mathrm{List}(\alpha)$, and function $f : \alpha \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, encode each Boolean by its corresponding element of $\mathrm{Fin}(2)$. The encoding of the conjunction of the values $f(x)$ over $x$ in $l$ equals the product in $\mathrm{Fin}(2)$ of their encodings.
